name: NFE2 like bZIP transcription factor 2
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: NFE2L2 encodes nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to immunodeficiency, developmental delay, and hypohomocysteinemia (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Hepatoblastoma; Lung squamous cell carcinoma; Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
